name: K3i
summary: K3i Co., Ltd. specializes in developing advanced extended reality (XR) solutions, encompassing technologies such as augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), and mixed reality (MR). The company delivers services built upon its unique "Universe Extended Reality framework," with applications across diverse sectors including industry, cultural tourism, and education. Founded on March 9, 2000, K3i maintains its principal operations in Daejeon, South Korea.
